Quantitative Developer — NYC

Join our systematic trading desk building low-latency market-making
infrastructure. You'll implement execution algorithms in C++ and work
closely with quant researchers on alpha signal productionization.

What you'll do:
- Build and maintain tick-data pipelines
- Implement FIX protocol adapters for new venues
- Optimize hot-path C++ with SIMD and lock-free queues
- Collaborate with researchers to deploy new trading strategies

Requirements: 5+ years C++, experience with market microstructure,
order book dynamics, or statistical arbitrage.

Base pay: $200,000 to $275,000 + bonus.
